entities.name: Tree of Perdition
entities.description: Executioner's tree in a courtyard at Thraben Cathedral on Innistrad, formerly the Tree of Redemption, which survived the cathedral's destruction as a twisted version of itself.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: Cathedral on Innistrad whose courtyard held the tree.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: Prison-artifact visible from the courtyard and later destroyed.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi whose arrival twisted the tree.

events.summary: After the destruction of the Cathedral and the Helvault and the arrival of Emrakul, the tree survived as a twisted version of its former self.
events.quote: the tree survived as a twisted version of its former self
